title: Against the Storm
shortDescription: A dark fantasy city builder where you must rebuild civilization in the face of apocalyptic rains. As the Queen’s Viceroy, lead humans, beavers, lizards, foxes, and harpies to reclaim the wilderness and secure a future for civilization's last survivors.
zhShortDescription: 黑暗幻想风格的城市建造 Roguelite，在永不停息的暴雨中建立并管理定居点。
description: You are the Viceroy – a leader charged by the Scorched Queen to reclaim the wilderness and discover lost riches for the Smoldering City, civilization's last bastion against the Blightstorm that destroyed the old world. Unlike most survival city builders where your focus is on a single city, in Against the Storm you must build a vast, prosperous network of settlements populated by diverse fantasy races, each with their own specializations and needs. The wilderness holds many hidden dangers, and never-ending storms will batter your population into submission. If your settlements should fall, then the expedition may end – but not the game. zhDescription: 《风暴之城》是一款黑暗幻想风格的城市建造 Roguelite 游戏。作为总督，你需要在永不停息的暴雨中建立定居点，满足女王的指令。每局游戏随机生成不同的建筑蓝图、资源和挑战，迫使你不断调整策略。融合了城市建造的资源管理和 Roguelike 的随机性与重玩性。

topReviews.review:
Most games have a shelf life. 
You play them, you finish them (or get bored), and you uninstall them to make room for the next big release. Against the Storm is the rare exception. It is one of the very few titles that has earned a permanent spot on my SSD. And i have over 200 hours of nplaytime xD

No matter how many flashy new games I play, Against the Storm always pulls me back. It is the ultimate "comfort game" for my brain

Why it Sticks:

topReviews.zh_review: 大多数游戏都有保质期——玩了、通关了（或玩腻了），然后卸载为下一款大作腾空间。《风暴之城》是罕见的例外。这是我SSD上少数几个永驻的游戏之一，我已经玩了200多小时。不管玩了多少炫酷新作，风暴之城总能把我拉回来。它是我大脑的终极'舒适游戏'。为什么戒不掉：完美的循环——因为是肉鸽城市建造，我不需要记得50小时战役停在哪。三个月没玩也能直接跳进去，15分钟就能回到状态。

topReviews.review: A lot of fun, great for people who like city builders but also feel like they don't have a lot of time for gaming. The difficulties scale and the game can be played in small bites in order to enjoy each game quite a bit. Offers great variety of building options in the game while keeping it spicy enough that you might have to work without all the things you want. Overall a very interesting game
topReviews.zh_review: 非常有趣，适合喜欢城市建造但时间不多的玩家。难度可调节，游戏可以分成小段享受。建筑选择丰富，同时保持足够的挑战性——有时候你不得不在缺少心仪建筑的条件下运营。总的来说非常有意思的游戏。
